statusDetail: Anton completed the scheduled site-improvement loop and recorded the result.
actionRequired: No action needed unless you want to review the latest commit.
summary:
Implemented the Anton/home status clarity slice.

Changed `anton.html` to add an iPhone Review Queue that reads `agent-last-run.json` and gives direct actions for: opening the changed page, checking the Home Monitor, reviewing the next action, and seeing the run trace. Also updated the Anton bottom action bar to `Review / Home / Controls / More`, bumped the service worker cache to `v344`, updated search metadata, and added browser-smoke coverage.

Verified:
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('anton.html')`
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('anton.html') -Tag audit-v344-anton-review-queue -SkipScreenshots`
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('index.html')`

Next safe slice: real-iPhone review of the new Anton queue/Home tile, shared search/offline regression check, or a practical Diagnostics/Quick Sheet follow-up.

Impact Score: 3/5
Visible Change: Anton now shows an iPhone Review Queue with direct post-run actions.
Impact Reason: It makes the Anton page more useful on iPhone by showing exactly what to review after a run instead of making the owner infer the next step.
